classification: Established exact-key and group-intersection methods; new authored local tool and executed synthetic functionality tests

sources.used_for: Unseen-group evaluation requires group separation; grouping is task/domain specific
sources.caveat: Supports evaluation rationale only; our counts are local outputs. No sklearn splitter or fitted model is used in the core tool.

sources.used_for: Group partition fractions refer to groups, so sample counts may differ
sources.caveat: Our fixture generator uses Python random, not this implementation; no claim of identical split membership.

sources.used_for: Stable digest labels over canonical bytes and exact file snapshots
sources.caveat: Hashes do not anonymize private values; full canonical bytes decide equality, including in forced-collision testing.

sources.section: DictReader, dialect strictness, newline handling and line_num
sources.used_for: Strict CSV parsing, explicit UTF-8 decoding and record-position interpretation
sources.caveat: One record may span multiple physical file lines; our positions are one-based data records.

sources.used_for: Exact finite decimal representation without context-dependent normalization rounding
sources.caveat: Equivalence policy is explicitly chosen, not a tolerance-based near-duplicate detector.

data.origin: Fresh authored synthetic CSV fixtures generated from declared config, plus a four-row common-feature counterexample
data.claims: Small development-visible functionality/stress tests, not independent scientific or enterprise validation

outcomes: Only the saved local results, complete per-case reports, row flags and executed CLI receipts support measured claims
runtime_dependencies: Python 3.12 standard library; Matplotlib/numpy optional for figures under their own licences
